# ABDM Developer Portal

> Documentation for integrating with ABDM, India's health data exchange: the HIE-CM gateway milestones M1 to M3, the ABHA, HPR and HFR registries, UHI, and the NHCX claims exchange between hospitals and insurers. Nothing here has been run against the ABDM sandbox unless a page says so, so treat request and response shapes as unconfirmed.

Add `.md` to any link below to get that page as markdown. Individual API operations are not listed here: each module has its own `llms.txt` naming every call it carries, linked under Optional. `llms-full.txt` beside this file carries every page in one document.

## docs/hiecm

- [Get started](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/hiecm/v3): Connect your application to India's Interoperable Digital Health Infrastructure, from sandbox credentials to your first call to going live.
- [API references](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/hiecm/v3/api): Every operation published for this gateway, module by module.
- [Gateway session](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/hiecm/v3/api/gateway): Every ABDM call carries a bearer token from one endpoint. This is that endpoint, plus the certificate and bridge registration calls that sit beside it.

- [Care contexts](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/hiecm/v3/concepts/care-context): A care context is a logical grouping of a patient's health records, and the unit that is associated with a patient's ABHA address.
- [Consent](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/hiecm/v3/concepts/consent): What a consent request is, what a consent artefact is, who holds it, and the states it moves through.
- [How a record travels](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/hiecm/v3/concepts/data-flow): The path a health record takes from the system that asks for it to the system that holds it, and the encryption in between.
- [Encryption](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/hiecm/v3/concepts/encryption): Which values must be encrypted before they go in a request body, why it is required, and why you encrypt inside your own system rather than through a helper.
- [FHIR and health record formats](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/hiecm/v3/concepts/fhir): The R4 profiles ABDM uses, the document bundle every record travels in, and how to validate one before you ship it.
- [The ABDM gateway](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/hiecm/v3/concepts/gateway): The routing layer every ABDM call goes through, and the session endpoint that issues your token.
- [Hospital, lab and pharmacy systems](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/hiecm/v3/concepts/hip-hiu): What a facility does as a health information provider in ABDM, and how care context linking fits into a clinical workflow.
- [How the pieces fit](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/hiecm/v3/concepts/how-it-fits): The registries, the HIE-CM gateway, the two roles a record moves between, and where a health record actually lives.
- [Care contexts and linking](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/hiecm/v3/concepts/linking): Why a record has to be linked before anyone can find it, the three routes onto the map, and how the link token works.
- [Ecosystem participants](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/hiecm/v3/concepts/participants): The eight participants on India's health data network, the identifier each one holds, and what each can do.
- [Citizen](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/hiecm/v3/concepts/participants/citizen): What an ABHA gives a person, what consent means in practice, and what a citizen controls on the network.
- [Doctor](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/hiecm/v3/concepts/participants/doctor): The HPR ID a healthcare professional holds, how it is issued, and what it unlocks for the facility they work in.
- [Hospital](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/hiecm/v3/concepts/participants/hospital): The facility ID a hospital holds, the HIP and HIU roles it takes, and what registering on ABDM gets it.
- [Insurer](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/hiecm/v3/concepts/participants/insurer): An insurer reads records as an HIU under consent, and settles claims on NHCX, a separate gateway with its own onboarding.
- [Diagnostics](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/hiecm/v3/concepts/participants/lab): A laboratory or imaging centre takes the same roles as a hospital, with a narrower record surface. What differs and what does not.
- [NHA](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/hiecm/v3/concepts/participants/nha): The National Health Authority runs ABDM. What it operates, what it issues, and what that gives the systems on the network.
- [Pharmacy](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/hiecm/v3/concepts/participants/pharmacy): A pharmacy takes the same roles as a hospital, with a narrower record surface. What differs, and what runs on another gateway.
- [Personal Health Record (PHR) Application](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/hiecm/v3/concepts/participants/phr): The citizen facing application: its role in ABDM, the capabilities each phase adds, and why it is where consent is managed.
- [Build it well](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/hiecm/v3/getting-started/build-it-well): What to validate before you call, what to do with each error, what is safe to retry, and what the person at the counter sees while it happens.
- [Build with AI](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/hiecm/v3/getting-started/build-with-ai): Set a coding agent up to build your ABDM integration, from a one-file skill to live retrieval over MCP.
- [Quickstart](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/hiecm/v3/getting-started/first-fifteen-minutes): Create a gateway session and then create your first ABHA, live from this page, with your own sandbox credentials.
- [Glossary](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/hiecm/v3/getting-started/glossary): The ABDM terms used across this documentation, and the HIE-CM ones, defined once.
- [Go live](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/hiecm/v3/getting-started/going-live): Stages 4 to 6 of sandbox integration. Functional testing and the security audit, the Health Tech Committee demonstration, then go live.
- [Get your sandbox credentials](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/hiecm/v3/getting-started/sandbox): The six stages of sandbox integration, then how to request sandbox access, receive credentials, register a callback URL and note the base URLs.
- [Security audit](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/hiecm/v3/getting-started/security-audit): Pass the WASA security audit and hold a Safe to Host certificate, which every application needs before it runs in production.
- [Milestones](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/hiecm/v3/milestones): The four milestones, Create, Attach, Retrieve and Enrol, in build order, plus the three PHR milestones and which ones you need.
- [M1 Identity: Create and verify ABHA](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/hiecm/v3/milestones/m1): Milestone 1 focuses on the creation and management of ABHA, the unique health identifier under ABDM, through ABDM-compliant workflows.
- [M2 Health Information Provider: Create and link records](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/hiecm/v3/milestones/m2): Milestone 2 enables a HIP to create digital health records, link them with an ABHA Address, support discovery through a PHR app and share encrypted records.
- [M3 Health Information User: Fetch data with consent](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/hiecm/v3/milestones/m3): Milestone 3 enables an HIU to request, receive and view a patient's health records from HIPs in a secure and consent-based manner.
- [Milestone 4 (M4): Register Healthcare Professionals and Facilities](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/hiecm/v3/milestones/m4): Milestone 4 establishes the identity of healthcare professionals on the HPR and the details of healthcare facilities on the HFR.
- [P1 Identity and login](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/hiecm/v3/milestones/p1): The patient side of M1: how a person registers in your PHR app, logs in, and which login routes are mandatory.
- [P2 Linking and records](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/hiecm/v3/milestones/p2): The patient side of M2: how a PHR app finds records held elsewhere, links them to an ABHA address, and shares a profile at a facility.
- [P3 Consent and notifications](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/hiecm/v3/milestones/p3): The patient side of M3: subscriptions, auto approval, granting and revoking consent, and fetching the records a grant covers.
- [Authentication](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/hiecm/v3/reference/authentication): The credentials every ABDM call carries, and the headers that go with them.
- [Error codes](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/hiecm/v3/reference/error-codes): Every error code the specifications carry, with its message and what to do.
- [Registries](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/hiecm/v3/registries): What an ABDM registry is, why there are two, and where ABHA, HPR and HFR sit.
- [ABHA Registry](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/hiecm/v3/registries/abha): The registry that identifies patients, the 14 digit ABHA number, the ABHA address, and what every milestone assumes about both.
- [NHPR, the provider registries](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/hiecm/v3/registries/nhpr): The National Health Professional Registry, why professionals and facilities are registered separately, and which one you need first.
- [HFR, the facility registry](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/hiecm/v3/registries/nhpr/hfr): The Health Facility Registry, what a facility record holds, the five call onboarding sequence, and how a bridge is linked to it.
- [HPR, the professional registry](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/hiecm/v3/registries/nhpr/hpr): The Healthcare Professionals Registry, the HPID, what identifies a doctor, and the registration journey.
- [Developer resources](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/hiecm/v3/resources): Test scenarios for ABDM integration and certification, and the documentation, AI-assisted tools and reference projects that support it.
- [When something breaks](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/hiecm/v3/troubleshooting): Find the symptom you are seeing, not the error code, and work through the checks in order.
- [Accepted, then nothing](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/hiecm/v3/troubleshooting/accepted-then-nothing): Discovery or care context linking started, the first call was accepted, and the flow stalled somewhere in the middle.
- [The callback never arrives](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/hiecm/v3/troubleshooting/callback-never-arrives): A call returned 202, and nothing followed on your registered callback URL. The checks in order.
- [Consent stuck in Requested](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/hiecm/v3/troubleshooting/consent-stuck-requested): A consent request was created and never moved to Granted or Denied. The checks in order.
- [Everything returns 401](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/hiecm/v3/troubleshooting/everything-returns-401): Every call fails the same way, not just one endpoint. The checks in order, before you assume the gateway is down.
- [The OTP never arrives](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/hiecm/v3/troubleshooting/otp-never-arrives): You requested an OTP and nothing reached the phone. The checks in order.
- [Use cases](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/hiecm/v3/use-cases): End-to-end workflows that sit on top of a milestone. Each one names the milestone it belongs to and the calls it uses.
- [Patient record share](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/hiecm/v3/use-cases/patient-record-share): A patient scans the QR code at your counter and pushes chosen records from their PHR app to your system, with no consent request raised by you.
- [Scan and Pay](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/hiecm/v3/use-cases/scan-and-pay): A patient scans the QR code at your counter, sees their open orders in their PHR app, pays there, and your system learns the payment status.
- [Scan and Register](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/hiecm/v3/use-cases/scan-and-register): A patient scans the QR code at your counter and shares their ABHA profile, so registration needs no typing and every record links to the right ABHA address.

- [Preauthorisation](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/nhcx/v1/roles/provider/preauthorisation): Preauth request submission, clinical attachments, and query handling

- [Provider UI guide](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/nhcx/v1/roles/provider/ui-guide): Provider desk wireframes and UX recommendations
- [NHCX support](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/nhcx/v1/support): Who to write to about NHCX integration, certification, FHIR bundles and credentials, and what to include so the call can be traced.
- [When something breaks](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/nhcx/v1/troubleshooting): Find the symptom you see, not the error code, and open the chapter that walks its checks
- [Accepted with 202, and no callback arrives](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/nhcx/v1/troubleshooting/accepted-then-no-callback): The exchange answered 202 and no callback followed: the six checks in order
- [Every NHCX call returns 401](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/nhcx/v1/troubleshooting/every-call-returns-401): Every endpoint fails the same way: the token, its prefix, its header or its environment
- [Responses arrive against the wrong request](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/nhcx/v1/troubleshooting/responses-arrive-against-the-wrong-request): Answers on the wrong case, duplicates refused, callbacks unmatched: correlation and API call IDs
- [The payer rejects your FHIR bundle](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/nhcx/v1/troubleshooting/the-payer-rejects-your-bundle): `PAYR-1004`, `PAYR-1008` and the missing identifier codes: validate, then check shape, identifiers and attachments
- [The recipient cannot decrypt your message](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/nhcx/v1/troubleshooting/the-recipient-cannot-decrypt): A `PAYR-1001` protocol response: the certificate, its cache, the algorithms and the compact form
- [Your callback URL is rejected or never called](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/nhcx/v1/troubleshooting/your-callback-url-is-rejected): The endpoint update is refused, or nothing ever reaches your server
- [What's new in NHCX](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/nhcx/v1/whats-new): Dated changes to what you can build against on NHCX, newest first.
- [21 September 2026](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/nhcx/v1/whats-new/2026-09-21): What changed in the NHCX documentation on 21 September 2026.
- [23 September 2026](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/nhcx/v1/whats-new/2026-09-23): What changed in the NHCX documentation on 23 September 2026.

## docs/support

- [Support](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/support): Where to raise integration queries, API errors, onboarding and certification questions for the ABDM sandbox.

## docs/uhi

- [Introduction](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/uhi/v1): What UHI is, the two roles you can build, and how far each service goes today.
- [UHI API reference](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/uhi/v1/api): What is published for the UHI gateway today, and where the message shapes come from.
- [UHI gateway](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/uhi/v1/concepts/network-and-protocol): The open network for discovering and booking health services, its two roles, and its signing scheme.
- [Ambulance booking](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/uhi/v1/concepts/services/ambulance-booking): Find an ambulance nearby and get a quote from the provider, using the two call pairs live in this service today.
- [AMRIT Pharmacy discovery](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/uhi/v1/concepts/services/amrit-pharmacy): Find AMRIT Pharmacy stores over UHI by store code, state and district, pincode or GPS radius.
- [Blood bank discovery](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/uhi/v1/concepts/services/blood-bank): Search live blood stock by group and component across registered blood banks, using one call pair.
- [Jan Aushadhi Kendra discovery](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/uhi/v1/concepts/services/jan-aushadhi-kendra): Find Jan Aushadhi Kendras over UHI by Kendra code, state and district, pincode or GPS radius.
- [Jan Aushadhi medicine search](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/uhi/v1/concepts/services/jan-aushadhi-medicine-search): Search the Jan Aushadhi medicine catalogue, then find the Kendras that stock a chosen medicine.
- [Physical consultation](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/uhi/v1/concepts/services/physical-consultation): Doctor discovery, appointment booking, PIN check-in and the full appointment lifecycle on UHI.
- [PM-JAY HEM hospital discovery](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/uhi/v1/concepts/services/pmjay-hem): Find PM-JAY empanelled hospitals over UHI by state, district, speciality, facility name, pincode or GPS.
- [Glossary](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/uhi/v1/getting-started/glossary): The ABDM terms UHI shares, and the two roles that belong to UHI alone.
- [Onboarding to UHI](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/uhi/v1/getting-started/onboarding): How an application joins the UHI network, from the M2 gate to sandbox sign-off and production go-live.
- [Registries](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/uhi/v1/registries): The registry UHI runs itself, the three ABDM identifiers that ride inside UHI messages, and which of them onboarding actually asks for.
- [ABHA on UHI](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/uhi/v1/registries/abha): Where a patient's ABHA address appears in UHI messages, in which services it is mandatory, and what UHI does not do with it.
- [HFR on UHI](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/uhi/v1/registries/hfr): The one UHI service that carries an HFR ID, the tag it travels in, and what is issued at onboarding.
- [HPR on UHI](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/uhi/v1/registries/hpr): Where a practitioner's HPR ID appears in a UHI catalogue and a UHI order, and the two forms it takes.
